_note: The Scud truck (GLOSSARY: Scud truck, Launcher, Lock point, Scud missile, Scud blast). Parsed by ScudFile (ShooterCore/Scud/ScudData.cs); every field is checked at load. launcher: the timings of the launcher machine and the targeting rules. targeting: the operator's bird's-eye screen. missile: the planned flight (a vertical boost, then one arc down onto the point) and who is warned. reload: loading a rocket from a rocket cart onto an empty truck (hold the interact key hold_seconds beside a truck with an empty rack and a loaded cart within cart_reach_m of its hull; a player on foot must be within player_reach_m; the truck or cart moving moved_cancel_m cancels it until the rocket leaves the cart at transfer_share of launcher.reload_seconds). blast: the impact (metres, hit points, seconds; chain_delay_seconds: a loaded cart doomed by a blast goes up that long after it). The numbers are a first guess and want a feel pass.
